=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2850-2856 (with .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4935-4976) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Enable auto-merge on PR" step passes SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED (line 4943) but not DEFAULT_BRANCH, and the codex-agent job does not set it either. As a result, `[ -n "${DEFAULT_BRANCH:-}" ]` in _pr_base_sync_inline_merge is false, inline_pass_required stays "false", and the security audit carry on the update head is skipped without any log line. The helper then returns 0 and the caller merges the update head.
  WHY: This turns a required security check off instead of failing closed. Before this PR, the pushed synchronize run's single_issue_security_pass / deterministic-skip-merge carry gated the merge. All reviewers rated it MAJOR or left severity unstated. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite named scripts/review_rb_judge.sh as the example caller missing DEFAULT_BRANCH, but the other reviewers cite review_autofix.yml:5119 exporting DEFAULT_BRANCH in the judge step. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash also notes that SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED at :4943 is passed raw, so an unset repo var reads as "" != "false" at pr_checks_lib.sh:2850, while the gate step (:4897, `|| 'false'`) treats it as disabled.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2904-2910 (also 2833-2835; scripts/review_head_gate.sh:36-41) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A failed head-gate success post is treated as success. Step 5 runs `_pr_base_sync_inline_post_status ... || true` and then `return 0`, and review_head_gate.sh:36-41 logs a failed status POST but still returns 0. The helper therefore exports PR_BASE_SYNC_INLINE_HEAD and the caller merges or enables auto-merge while ai-review/head-gate is pending, with no dispatch.
  WHY: This breaks the helper's contract that "Every failure after the precondition dispatches the PR's review once" and leaves the head without an owner. Three reviewers rated it MAJOR. minimax_minimax-m3 disagrees: it calls the step-5 `|| true` INTENTIONAL (a defensive idempotent re-post) and rates it NIT with confidence 5 that it is not a defect.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:1264-1287 (interacts with lines 173-181) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: On synchronize, the pushed run's early `review_head_gate.sh gate` call posts `pending` and disables the owner's already-enabled auto-merge. gate_lease_inline_owner_active then returns 0 for a queued/in_progress owner and exits with SKIP_REASON=lease_inline_owner_active.
  WHY: Nothing re-enables the merge or re-posts success, so the PR stalls with auto-merge withdrawn and head-gate pending. This is reachable whenever the pushed run is queued longer than the owner's quick-CI wait. Suggested fix: return 1 when "${pr_auto_merge_enabled}" = "true".
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:5065-5136 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked judge env block exports DEFAULT_BRANCH (5119), SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED (5120) and SECURITY_PASS_* (5124-5136) but not AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS. The check at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2859 therefore fails, and the helper returns 1 with reason=security_pass.
  WHY: Every inline merge attempted from the judge (review_rb_judge.sh lines 2835, 2957, 3532) short-circuits to a dispatched review run, which breaks the Phase 4 contract for the judge path. The same root cause is reported as a task gap below.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Step 3 of `_pr_base_sync_inline_merge`: "Run the security audit carry exactly as the `deterministic-skip-merge` job does when `AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS=true`", for all listed call sites including scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh and scripts/review_rb_judge.sh.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml: the "Review-blocked judge decision" step env block (5071-5136) and the "Enable auto-merge on PR" step env block (4935-4974), plus the codex-agent support checkout; scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh `_pr_base_sync_inline_merge` (2858-2862).
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Neither codex-agent step sets AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS, which appears only at lines 780 and 1282, so the `${AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS:-false}` check at pr_checks_lib.sh:2859 always fails. The codex-agent job never creates `${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.codex-skip-pr-head` (the only checkout is at :1352 in deterministic-skip-merge), so :2862 also fails. Both env blocks lack DEFAULT_BRANCH / AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS / the supporting security-pass vars, unlike the deterministic-skip-merge env (1416-1437/1440). On the judge path the inline merge always hands off with reason=security_pass, which fails closed but makes the deliverable dead code there. No diff hunk wires the carry's inputs into codex-agent.
- requirement: "Add tests/test_merge_lease_inline_sync.py ... and wire it into .github/workflows/ci.yml."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/ci.yml
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: No diff hunk in .github/workflows/ci.yml introduces the new test file, and ci.yml is not in PR CHANGED FILES. google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated this MAJOR. minimax_minimax-m3 rated it NIT because the `tests-system-python` catch-all already collects it by glob. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly declined to report it: the catch-all at ci.yml:4455 / 4741-4754 runs it, and ci.yml is outside files_touched.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2850-2856 (with .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4935-4974) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "Enable auto-merge on PR" step passes SINGLE_ISSUE_SECURITY_PASS_ENABLED (line 4943) but not DEFAULT_BRANCH, which is set only at lines 782, 1368, 1417, 4896 and 5119. `[ -n "${DEFAULT_BRANCH:-}" ]` is therefore always false, inline_pass_required stays "false", and step 3 is skipped without any log line.
  WHY: The caller enables the head-bound merge with no security carry on the update head, so a missing env var turns a required check off instead of failing closed. Suggested fix: set inline_pass_required="true" when the pass is enabled and DEFAULT_BRANCH is empty, and add `DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}` to the step env.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:1264-1287 (with lines 173-181) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The pushed run's early head-gate call disables the owner's auto-merge and posts pending. gate_lease_inline_owner_active then returns 0 (`queued|in_progress) return 0 ;;`) and the run exits with lease_inline_owner_active.
  WHY: Nothing re-enables the merge or re-posts success, so the PR stalls. Suggested fix: return 1 when "${pr_auto_merge_enabled}" = "true".
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2906 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The step 5 re-post `_pr_base_sync_inline_post_status ... || true` ignores failure and the helper returns 0 with dispatch=none.
  WHY: The caller enables the merge while head-gate is pending and no review is dispatched, which breaks the contract that a failure never leaves the head without an owner. Suggested fix: `|| { _pr_base_sync_inline_finish head_gate_status; return 1; }`.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Step 3: "Run the security audit carry exactly as the `deterministic-skip-merge` job does when `AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS=true`", for every call site including review_enable_auto_merge.sh and review_rb_judge.sh.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:4935-4974 and 5071-5136 env blocks; scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2858-2862.
  Evidence of absence: AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS appears only at lines 780 and 1282, and `.codex-skip-pr-head` exists only at line 1352. The judge path, and the auto-merge path once DEFAULT_BRANCH is fixed, therefore always ends with reason=security_pass. This fails closed, but the inline merge never succeeds in those callers.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- NOTE: Declined the ci.yml TASK_GAP because the `tests-system-python` catch-all (.github/workflows/ci.yml:4455) runs the test. Judged the last-run absolute `inline_lib` change correct.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: (2 related items) For the empty DEFAULT_BRANCH, fail closed in the predicate (2850-2856, 2 lines). For step 5, replace `|| true` with a finish+return 1 (line 2906, 1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
